stories.title: Energy price cap to rise 4% from October, taking typical bill to £1,723
stories.summary: Energy bills for households on default tariffs will rise by 4% from 1 October, taking a typical annual bill to £1,723. Ofgem announced the new price cap on Wednesday morning, covering the period from 1 October to 31 December.
